title: sdui_core v2.0 Payload
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for sdui_core v2.0 server-driven UI payloads. v2.0 adds a root-level metadata object and makes node fields explicit.

sdui_version.description: Schema version identifier. Must be "2.0" for this schema.

metadata.description: Optional root-level metadata for analytics, A/B experiments, or deployment context. Not rendered — forwarded as-is to observability integrations.

root.description: The root node of the UI tree.

node.description: v2.0 nodes require version, props, and actions to be explicit.

type.description: Registered widget type string, e.g. "sdui:column" or "myapp:banner".

id.description: Stable, server-assigned identifier used for diffing. Must be unique across the entire tree. Prefer snake_case with no spaces.

version.description: Required in v2.0. Increment when this node's content changes. The renderer rebuilds only nodes whose version increases.

props.description: Required in v2.0 (use {} if no props). Arbitrary key/value data forwarded to the widget builder.

actions.description: Required in v2.0 (use {} if no actions). Named gesture handlers keyed by trigger name, e.g. "onTap".

action.description: Describes a side-effect triggered by a user gesture.

event.description: Event name forwarded to the registered Dart action handler.

payload.description: Arbitrary key/value data passed to the action handler.
